title: Making a Skincare Store Easier to Shop
viewer: Store owner, website helper, or portfolio reviewer
takeaway: The owner can see where shoppers get stuck, which fixes come first, and what to measure after changes.

scenes.intent: Shoppers could lose confidence before choosing a product. The owner needed to know where and why.
scenes.headline: Shoppers could lose confidence before choosing.

scenes.intent: I followed the same path a shopper would. Homepage, assessment, product list, and product page.
scenes.headline: I followed the shopper's full path.

scenes.intent: Five problems made choosing and buying harder. The empty assessment became the first fix.
scenes.headline: Five problems made buying harder.
scenes.assetAlt: Public online-store review showing shopper friction and the recommended priority order.

scenes.intent: The same 18 public pages were checked on both devices. All 36 page captures completed successfully.
scenes.headline: Desktop and mobile checks matched.
scenes.assetAlt: Public shopping-review report used as evidence of desktop and mobile checks.

scenes.intent: The findings became seven fixes in a clear order. Each fix names a result to watch.
scenes.headline: The findings became an ordered fix list.
scenes.assetAlt: Public shopping-review report with the ordered recommendation sequence.

hide: private store dashboard, sales reports, customer information, and website-admin access
private account data and private report pages
unproven sales, conversion, health, or product outcomes
safe: public shopping-review preview used by the case study
published counts, findings, and ordered-fix framing
plain synthetic shopper-path and finding labels
